oauth.failedBody: Your session could not be loaded. Please sign in again.

errors.state: That sign-in expired or was started in another browser. Please try again.
errors.provider: The sign-in with that provider did not complete. Please try again.
errors.email_unverified: That account has no verified email address, so purestat cannot use it. Verify your address with the provider (on GitHub, your primary address), or sign up with an email and password.
errors.account_exists: An account with this email address already exists and has not confirmed the address. Sign in with your email and password.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.server: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again.

site.name: Site name
site.trackingInstructions: Add this script to your website's <head> tag:

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.fromEntry: Next pages from an entry page
journeys.noGoals: No goals yet: create one on the Goals page
journeys.pickEntry: Pick the page the visits entered on.
journeys.tooFew: Fewer than {min} visitors took this route in this period. A journey only shows paths that at least {min} visitors followed.
journeys.legend: Flows are visits. Exit: the visit ended. Entered: the visit started there. Other: pages followed by fewer than 5 visitors, and pages past the ones shown.
journeys.explain: A path is a visit's pages in order, a reload counted once, on the day the visit started (UTC). To keep any one visitor's path private, a path followed by fewer than 5 visitors is never shown: its visits are grouped as Other.
